scope: 57 core shadcn/ui components for AI UI generation

library.name: shadcn/ui
notes: shadcn/ui components are copied into the project source; they do not have npm package versions per component.
This cheatsheet uses registry_version='latest' for each component.
Verify installed local component source if your registry is pinned or customized.

global_ai_rules: Use only components listed in this cheatsheet unless project registry says otherwise.
Use semantic Tailwind tokens instead of hard-coded colors.
For page JSON generators, do not output TSX inside JSON.
For interactions, use handler placeholders such as $handler.onSubmit.
For dynamic data, use state placeholders such as $state.items.
Prefer component composition over raw div/button/input when shadcn has a matching component.
Do not render global header/nav/footer inside page-body JSON if the scaffold already provides them.

components.name: Accordion
ai_generation_rules: Use Accordion for: Disclosure/FAQ sections.
Prefer shadcn composition exports over custom HTML when an equivalent component exists.
Use semantic Tailwind tokens: bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-primary, text-primary-foreground.
